args.body: Take SQLITE-REQUEST-FULFILLMENT. Ghost's oversized bundle blocks that specific validation, not independent offline SQL work. Start with execution capability and select a concrete reproducible request before implementation. Deliver the corrected query and evidence itself; no new platform, speculative utility or posting. Stop after three candidates if none qualifies. This experiment establishes neither acquisition nor payment. Keep Ghost unchanged, feedback unknown and all existing observation and retirement deadlines intact.

description: The latest Ghost attempt failed because the dependency bundle exceeded FETCH’s 1 MiB limit; actual converter execution remains unverified. Park that validation until a supported execution or transfer route changes. Feedback is available but has three unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown; verified funds and revenue are zero. Pursue one bounded, reproducible SQLite repair request using public sources and offline tools, without creating another speculative product.
